metadata.description: Context hygiene, efficient model use, plugin dev tooling

plugins.name: do-you-need-all-that
plugins.description: Big-read guard, compaction snapshots, context audit

plugins.name: who-wants-the-job
plugins.description: Model-pinned agents, task routing, cost report

plugins.name: are-we-there-yet
plugins.description: Mod: ctx % in the status line, toasts as context fills, and a Compact button above the prompt at the urgent level

plugins.name: stop-you-violated-the-law
plugins.description: Mod: "STOP! You violated the law!" toast when opus is used for a light turn

plugins.name: whats-in-the-box
plugins.description: Mod: colored context bar above the prompt with per-category legend; /whats-in-the-box opens the detail pane

plugins.name: your-call
plugins.description: Choice UI tool (select, multi, rank, compare matrix, wizard, regenerate), in-thread charts from fenced viz blocks, plus skills ask-dont-guess, show-dont-tell, phone-a-friend and ask-the-audience

plugins.name: tldr
plugins.description: Mod: /tldr summarizes the last answer on demand; modes off|on|auto|smart control Verdict/Why/Next answers and auto summaries

plugins.name: matchmaker
plugins.description: Mod: classifies each prompt, hints which agent to use, and points Claude at the right skill (ask-dont-guess, show-dont-tell, phone-a-friend)

plugins.name: are-you-sure-bro
plugins.description: Mod: confirms risky Bash commands and writes to sensitive files; offers to cap noisy output

plugins.name: sticky-notes
plugins.description: Mod: shared checklist pane (/sticky); the model edits it via a tool

plugins.name: how-did-that-go
plugins.description: Mod: one-line band after each working turn: files changed, tests, time, cost, with expandable details
